description.zh: 在任何地方打出缩写，再按空格或标点，就换成设好的文字：cmd 变成 command，;addr 变成你的地址。紧接着按退格可以撤回。管理员身份运行的窗口里用不了
description.en: Type an abbreviation anywhere, then a space or punctuation, and it becomes the text you set: cmd becomes command, ;addr your address. Backspace right after takes it back. Not in windows run as administrator

hint.zh: 每行一条：缩写 = 换成的文字，如 cmd = command。内容要分几行时，接着往下写（下一行不带“=”）。缩写首字母大写或全大写时，内容跟着变（Btw → By the way）。# 开头的行不算
hint.en: One a line: abbreviation = text, such as cmd = command. For text of several lines, go on below (lines without “=”). Typed with a capital first letter or in capitals, the text follows (Btw → By the way). Lines starting with # do not count

title.zh: 打完缩写立刻换，不等空格或标点
title.en: Expand as soon as it is typed, without a space or punctuation

hint.zh: 适合以 ; 之类符号开头、不会是别的词一部分的缩写，如 ;sig
hint.en: For abbreviations that start with a sign such as ; and are part of no other word, such as ;sig

hint.zh: 程序名用分号隔开，例如 code.exe;mstsc.exe
hint.en: Program names separated by semicolons, e.g. code.exe;mstsc.exe
